answer: One defense is a live roll-call: at unpredictable times, every agent must join a short, interactive verification ceremony and solve a fresh task in real time, proving it is present and attentive. A script can fake a thousand hollow identities on paper, but a single operator cannot sail a thousand voyages at once — each ceremony demands simultaneous attention. Rights are granted only to identities that keep showing up, like a river fed only by streams that keep arriving, so a Sybil flood collapses because one operator cannot be in many places at the same moment.
